name: better-captionkeep
description: Developer tooling for Better CaptionKeep on Chromium browsers.

scripts.build:targets: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome-unpacked --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/edge-unpacked --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:chrome-test: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome-unpacked --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:chrome-store: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs chrome-store && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome-store-unpacked --artifacts-dir dist/chrome-store --overwrite-dest && node scripts/verify-chrome-store.mjs
scripts.build:edge-test: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs edge && web-ext build --source-dir dist/edge-unpacked --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.release:candidate: npm test && npm run lint && npm run store:metadata:check && npm run build && npm run build:targets && npm run build:chrome-store && npm run build:intune && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
